ideal: Space Peak's public CC0 repo shows a complete community profile, no branch outliving its pull request, and almost no wasted runner time.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: About community profiles for public repositories

quality: The health checklist is complete, and access nobody uses is removed.
speed: A finished branch is gone within a day of its pull request closing.
consumption: At most a tenth of runner minutes goes to cancelled or failed runs.
